items.title: Thai Lion Air claimed by Qilin
items.summary: The Qilin ransomware group listed Thai low-cost carrier Thai Lion Air as a victim, with the claim discovered on October 2, 2026.

items.title: Forma Therapeutics Holdings listed on leak site
items.summary: Biopharma firm Forma Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. was posted as a ransomware victim on October 3, 2026, with the intrusion estimated to have occurred around September 21.

items.title: Mat Bao Corporation claimed by Rhysida
items.summary: The Rhysida ransomware group claimed Vietnamese hosting and domain provider Mat Bao Corporation, with the listing discovered on October 2, 2026.

items.title: Holly Poultry (Baltimore) — 435 GB reportedly exfiltrated
items.summary: Baltimore, Maryland food distributor Holly Poultry was named as a ransomware victim in October 2026, with attackers claiming 435 GB of exfiltrated data.

items.title: Qilin hits Japanese freight and logistics company
items.summary: AhnLab's week-1 October dark web roundup reports a Qilin ransomware attack on a Japanese freight and logistics company.

items.title: Ransomware data theft up 275% in 2026
items.summary: New analysis finds ransomware-linked data theft surged 275% in 2026, with schools, hospitals and government agencies accounting for some of the largest claims.

ransomware.note: Victim listings are leak-site claims from the first three days of October and are not independently confirmed by the named organizations.

items.title: Azure: two incidents hit 18 regions in 40 hours
items.summary: Between September 29 and October 1, Azure logged two separate outages that took gateway services offline across 18 regions and left Azure OpenAI customers in Sweden with failed API calls for nearly six hours.

items.title: AWS us-east-1 outage runs 28 hours after cooling failure
items.summary: A physical cooling failure caused a 28-hour disruption in AWS us-east-1, the region's third major failure after the 2021 scaling bug and the October 2025 DNS race condition.

items.title: Cloudflare, Twilio and Zoom reporting problems
items.summary: An outage tracker shows Cloudflare, Twilio and Zoom reporting problems in early October, while AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure show normal operation.

items.title: Forrester's two-major-cloud-outage prediction for 2026
items.summary: Forrester predicted at least two major multi-day hyperscaler outages in 2026, a forecast this year's AWS and Azure incidents are tracking against.

outage.note: The AWS us-east-1 item's exact date was not confirmed in search results; it is recent but may predate October.

items.title: Fortinet FortiMail zero-day (CVE-2026-104286) added to KEV
items.summary: CISA added a CVSS 9.8 FortiMail flaw allowing unauthenticated arbitrary file writes to the KEV catalog on October 2, with federal agencies directed to patch or mitigate by October 4.

items.title: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway zero-days exploited globally
items.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 to KEV; each critical flaw can independently enable remote code execution and both are under active exploitation worldwide.

items.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager auth bypass added to KEV
items.summary: CISA added a critical authentication bypass in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager to the KEV catalog on October 1 following reports of active exploitation.

items.title: Zammad zero-day chain (CVE-2026-102489) exploited in the wild
items.summary: A CVSS 8.7 session-hijack flaw leading to remote code execution in Zammad helpdesk versions 6.3.0 through 6.5.4 was added to KEV on October 2 after in-the-wild exploitation.

items.title: Hurricane Nolo skirting Hawaii
items.summary: Hurricane Nolo is passing near Hawaii and could still bring powerful winds and flash flooding to the islands.

items.title: Uttar Pradesh flooding kills at least 62
items.summary: At least 62 people have died after days of heavy rain and flooding in India's northern Uttar Pradesh state.

items.title: Spain: heavy rain and flood alerts for Valencia, Castellon, Tarragona
items.summary: Spain's weather agency issued special alerts for heavy rain and flooding on October 1–2, with the highest risk in Valencia, Castellon and Tarragona provinces.

items.title: Nepal avalanche toll rises to 15 on Mount Himlung
items.summary: The death toll from an avalanche in Nepal rose to 15 after eight more bodies were found on Mount Himlung.

items.title: Atlantic enters October with no hurricane this season
items.summary: Eight Atlantic storms have been named in 2026 but none reached hurricane strength, a first in the modern satellite era, extending the basin's hurricane drought beyond 11 months.

items.title: M 4.7 earthquake near Korumburra, Australia
items.summary: A magnitude 4.7 earthquake struck 5 km NNE of Korumburra, Victoria on October 2; USGS alert level green, no tsunami.

items.title: M 4.2 earthquake near Wauna, Washington
items.summary: A magnitude 4.2 earthquake struck 6 km WNW of Wauna, Washington on September 29; USGS alert level green, no tsunami.

physical.note: No significant earthquakes above M 5 in the USGS significant-events feed this week.
